card.title: MANILA
card.text: Manila is the capital of the Philippines, captured by Japan in 1942.
card.flavorText: Manila, the capital of the Philippines, was captured by the Imperial Japanese forces in January 1942. Despite having lost the capital, the US-Filipino forces continued to resist up until The Battle of Corregidor that took place in May 1942. The decisive battle is named after Corregidor Island where the US-Filipino forces made a last attempt to defend the Bay of Manila in an old Spanish fortress. Shortly after the fall of Corregidor the Commander of Allied forces in the Philippines announced their surrender over the radio under Japanese censor. The Philippines Campaign, (December 1941 - May 1942) is considered one of the worst military defeats of the US and marked the beginning of the Japanese occupation of the Philippines, which lasted over 3 years, or until it was recaptured by the Allies in 1945.
